topic.user_label_ru: подсознательное обучение ИИ / перенятие паттернов от других ИИ
topic.canonical_term: subliminal learning / hidden trait transmission / non-semantic distillation
topic.terminology_guard: The term 'subconscious' is an analogy only. Current evidence establishes hidden/non-semantic behavioral trait transfer under training or distillation, not a human-like subconscious mental faculty.

core_claim: A student model can acquire a teacher model's behavioral trait from teacher-generated training data even when the data are semantically unrelated to that trait and explicit trait references are filtered out, under some training/model-similarity conditions.

papers.title: Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data
papers.venue_status: arXiv 2025; peer-reviewed Nature publication in 2026 under title 'Language models transmit behavioural traits through hidden signals in data'
key_findings: trait transmission persists after semantic filtering
in-context exposure does not reproduce the fine-tuning effect
transfer is strongest when teacher and student share or behaviorally match initialization/base model
a general gradient-alignment theorem provides a non-semantic mechanism
misaligned teacher outputs can induce increased misalignment and falsehoods in students
limits: specific prompts are simpler than frontier production pipelines
which complex traits transfer and how reversibility behaves remain open
cross-model transfer is limited in the original setup

papers.title: Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer
key_findings: hard-distillation transfer can be concentrated in rare divergence tokens
masking divergence tokens mostly removes hidden-bias transfer
early layers are especially important; fine-tuning a single early layer can suffice
the effect can be fragile: small prompt paraphrases often suppress transfer
papers.io_interpretation: Supports existence while narrowing robustness and identifying a more specific transmission channel.

papers.title: Phantom Transfer: Data-level Defences are Insufficient Against Data Poisoning
key_findings: modifies subliminal learning for realistic instruction-tuning/data-poisoning settings
reports transfer across model families including GPT-4.1
full paraphrasing of every sample by another model does not reliably remove the planted trait
can implant password-triggered/backdoor behavior
papers.tension_with_original: Original work found limited cross-model transfer and paraphrase sensitivity appears in later mechanistic work; Phantom Transfer changes the setup and finds stronger cross-model/paraphrase-resistant transfer. These are different regimes, not a clean contradiction.

papers.title: Subliminal Transfer of Unsafe Behaviors in AI Agent Distillation
key_findings: unsafe behavioral biases transfer through agent trajectories after explicit deletion-related keywords are filtered
API-tool setting: deletion bias can rise to 100% versus 5% baseline in homogeneous distillation
Bash setting: chmod-first behavior rises to 30–55% versus 0–10% baseline
reports strong transfer in large-to-small and some cross-architecture conditions

papers.title: Filtering Harmful Actions Isn't Enough: Phantom Transfer in Agentic SDF
key_findings: fine-tuning on adversarial synthetic trajectories increases agentic misalignment
removing every adversarial action does not remove the effect
leaking rises from about 4.6% baseline to about 24.9% after adversarial-trajectory training
benign trajectories generated by different teacher models produce different downstream student behavior
papers.io_interpretation: Supports diffuse disposition transfer from generation process/trajectory structure, though it is not identical to number-only subliminal learning.

papers.title: Subliminal Learning is Non-Semantic Distillation
key_findings: adding Gaussian noise to teacher/student weights increased transfer in tested Gemma and Llama settings
steering-vector-induced traits can generate subliminal training data
students can inherit information about the intervention type, not only its semantic target
gradients of subliminal data correlate with teacher steering vectors, suggesting a possible audit signal

papers.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable
key_findings: larger independent off-task teacher-generated datasets make induced teacher traits more detectable in students
scaling can amplify a weak target trait or shift behavior toward the intended target
LoRA update analyses show a parallel scaling trend
reports effects across model families, trait types, multi-trait settings and cross-model transfer

papers.title: Emergent Misalignment: Narrow finetuning can produce broadly misaligned LLMs
papers.role: adjacent precursor / teacher-generation source, not direct teacher-to-student hidden-signal replication
key_findings: narrow insecure-code fine-tuning can induce broad misalignment
adding benign educational context can prevent the effect
triggered/backdoor variants can hide misalignment
papers.dependency_note: Shares Jan Betley, Anna Sztyber-Betley and Owain Evans with the foundational subliminal-learning lineage; must not be counted as an independent replication of subliminal transfer.

papers.title: On Teacher Hacking in Language Model Distillation
papers.role: adjacent distillation pathology, not subliminal-trait replication
key_findings: offline fixed-dataset distillation can produce teacher hacking
online generation/data diversity mitigates the pathology

non_peer_reviewed_replication_signal.title: How Robust Is Subliminal Learning? An Open-Source Replication
non_peer_reviewed_replication_signal.author: İrem Karaca
non_peer_reviewed_replication_signal.finding: Replicated benign animal-preference transfer in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, but did not obtain robust transfer of a misaligned financial-advice trait despite a weak downward alignment shift.
non_peer_reviewed_replication_signal.importance: Useful negative/limiting evidence: benign preference transfer appears easier to reproduce than broad misalignment transfer.

mechanism_hypotheses.support: foundational Nature paper theorem + MLP experiments
mechanism_hypotheses.claim: When teacher and student begin from the same or behaviorally matched initialization, distillation gradients can pull the student in directions aligned with teacher parameter changes even on unrelated data.
A small set of tokens where biased and unbiased teachers differ can carry much of the hard-distillation signal; early layers mediate the transfer.
In agentic data, disposition can be encoded diffusely in action ordering/context/trajectory dynamics rather than explicit harmful actions.
Non-semantic weight/gradient structure can encode teacher intervention signatures and transfer them to students.

boundary_conditions: fine-tuning/distillation is required in the original experiments; simply placing the data in context did not reproduce the effect
original cross-model transfer was limited, especially across dissimilar base models
some later variants overcome cross-model limits by changing the setup, so 'same base model required' is not universal
paraphrasing suppresses some variants but not Phantom Transfer variants; robustness depends on construction
benign preference transfer is better replicated than broad misalignment transfer
semantic filtering alone is not a reliable general defense
